pages.title: Absolute Infinity
pages.text: Cantor's absolute infinity: larger than every infinity, larger than any set that can be formed, beyond comprehension by definition. It cannot be conceived, yet here it is in my hand, without size or edge. Looking at it, my eyes slide off and I forget what I was counting.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Only the Omnilex Engine, simulating the World Tree and the Ocean of Laws together under a Primordial Law, could reach it. It added every infinity together and found one more on top. That was it.
